messages.content: Can you write a short note to the team at Rosemary Lane Bakery about the online ordering test? From 6 to 19 October, half of website visitors saw a new one-page order form and half saw the old three-step form. The new form had 212 orders from 3,050 visits and the old form had 198 orders from 3,010 visits. Our web developer, Tomas Reyes, says the difference is too small to tell apart from chance, so the test is inconclusive so far. Please don't use em dashes. Describe the result accurately, without overstating it.

response:
Hi all, our flour deliveries from Tollworth Mill now arrive on Monday and Thursday mornings instead of Tuesday. The driver comes to the delivery door by the bins, not the shop front. Each delivery is twelve 16kg sacks, so please clear the lower shelf in the dry store the evening before. Whoever opens on those days signs the delivery note and puts it in the blue folder by the till, where the invoices are kept.
